transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to run the sign-off round for Echo Chamber before I can approve the public operating plan. The installation is scheduled to open Saturday, so let's move through this efficiently. I'd like to hear from our technical, rights, accessibility, and risk leads in turn. Please report any confirmed requirements you have regarding the current draft plan — that's 12 visitors per session, visitor photography permitted, one general admission queue, and one floor attendant. Who'd like to start?
